description: REVEL ensemble missense pathogenicity scores, keyed chr:pos:ref:alt (GRCh38). Score 0-1, higher = more pathogenic. ClinGen/Pejaver-2022 calibrated PP3/BP4 thresholds.
notes: Fixture hand-crafted (5 CSV rows -> 3 variants; one variant is a 2-transcript dedup, one row skipped for empty grch38_pos). NOT real REVEL data.

test_cases.description: Variant lookup by chr:pos:ref:alt ID resolves a Revel record
Entry ID is chr:pos:ref:alt (3 colon-separated fields)
Multi-transcript rows collapse to one variant with MAX REVEL + all transcript ids
CEL filter for high-REVEL (revel > 0.5) keeps pathogenic-leaning variants
